added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the refit table reports only aggregate medians (loops 1-14, loops 15-27, probes) per refit while the done-when requires per-channel slope and r for all 44 channels under each of the three refits, so the artifact under-reports its own measure and the per-channel refit values are readable only in the run-dir residual_rca.json.

follow-on: the probes column header reads "med slope / med r" without the absolute-value bars the loops columns carry, yet the saved values are magnitudes, so under a signed reading the "probe axes flipped" row appears identical to plain and contradicts the prose at docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html:191 that the flip negates each probe slope.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; 1f1fae117948 is a single commit adding 201 lines to the one evidence fragment, changing no source and no test.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when requires the per-channel slope and Pearson r for all 27 loops and 17 probes under three refits; docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html:16 gives per-channel values for the plain fit only and docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html:153 gives aggregate medians per refit, so the per-channel-under-refit report is not delivered.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to find what leaves JT-60SA's turn-corrected vacuum prediction short of slope 1 and loops 1 to 14 untracked; docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html:195 attributes the residual to the operator's per-coil response pattern G_pf and names the specific geometry defect inconclusive.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete; tests is `python -I vacuum_residual_rca.py` exit 0, test_logs names residual_refits.log and free_per_coil_fit.log; the read-only node declares no baseline_suite/after_suite, which is expected for a node that changes no source or tests.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html and a figures dir; git show --name-only 1f1fae117948 lists exactly docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html and nothing else, inside the declaration.

justifications.durability: no test is added (a docs node has no behaviour to regress) and the measurement script vacuum_residual_rca.py and the full residual_rca.json live only in the run directory, so the numbers in docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html cannot be regenerated from the repository.
justifications.evidence: the per-channel plain slopes/r in docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html:16 and the refit medians in docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html:153 reconcile with the run's residual_rca.json, but the done-when's per-channel-under-refit values exist only in that run-dir JSON, and the moved/flipped medians are absent from the named logs residual_refits.log and free_per_coil_fit.log.
justifications.fit: docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html follows the sibling evidence-fragment HTML idiom, every element id is prefixed with the node id (e.g. docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html:16 id=jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca-base), and it introduces no forbidden name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html:195 answers the goal by attributing the residual scale and the untracked loops 1-14 to the operator's per-coil pattern (G_pf) and names the specific defect inconclusive, so the question "what leaves it short" is answered at the level G_pf without naming the exact geometry fault.
justifications.reuse: the fragment adds no definition; it reuses imas_ambix/gs/operator.py read_geometry_table and vacuum_prediction, and no capability is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --name-only 1f1fae117948 lists only docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-residual-rca.html, which is inside the manifest's declared write paths, and the node changed no source or test.
